definitions.explanation: The seven vertebrae of the neck, at the top of the spinal column. Familiar to most people from injuries such as whiplash and from disc problems.

examples.japanese: {頚椎|けいつい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}めた→痛める：13613_itameru⟧。
{頚椎|けいつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had an X-ray taken of my cervical spine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しびれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、{頚椎|けいつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The numbness in my hands continued after the accident, and a problem was found in my cervical spine.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written {頸椎|けいつい}. {頸|けい} is the form used in medical writing, while {頚|けい} is the simplified variant common in everyday text; both are read けいつい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頚椎|けいつい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧: to injure one's cervical spine
- {頚椎|けいつい}⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧: cervical spine injury
- {頚椎|けいつい}ヘルニア: cervical disc herniation
- {頚椎|けいつい}ねんざ: neck sprain, whiplash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧: the backbone — the everyday word for the spine as a whole
- ⟦{腰椎|ようつい}→腰椎：30398_youtsui⟧: lumbar vertebrae — the lower back section
